description: Ollama configuration for DevOptimizer multi-model runner

notes.allow: Array of strings. Models containing any of these strings will be included. Empty array means include all models.
notes.deny: Array of strings. Models containing any of these strings will be excluded. Empty array means exclude none.
notes.concurrency: Number of models to run in parallel. 1 = sequential, 2+ = parallel. Consider system resources.
notes.timeout_seconds: Maximum time to wait for each model to respond.
notes.default_output_dir: Default directory for output files when not specified in command line.
